title: PCL: Peer-Contrastive Learning with Diverse Augmentations for Unsupervised Sentence Embeddings

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating sentence embedding performance on Semantic Textual Similarity (STS) benchmarks to assess whether models rely on superficial data features (such as word order, n-grams, bag-of-words, or sentence length) introduced by mono-augmenting strategies, rather than learning true semantic meaning.
